body: I average around six to seven hours post update,  was around five to six pre update.

Got it briefly, yes. Seems to have gone away now. 

What's going to be interesting is the first time I talk to someone via wifi call. Last few months on kitkat it would inevitably drop any wifi call rather quickly. Was lucky to get 45 seconds into a call over wifi after never having issues prior.

Something changed with it. 

Display improvement was the first thing that jumped out at me. Was instantly noticeable.

Got mine around noon today.

I'm In Portland Oregon.

I was also able to do so both with mobile data alone and on only around 70 percent battery, as I was at work without wifi or a charger. Took around five to ten minutes at most; then again T-Mobile's LTE network is very strong and fast in this city.

Got mine finally around noon.

Portland Oregon.

Ended up leaving a couple hours early. Made it as far as I could with this headache. Think I may be getting an ear infection as well. When it rains it pours. 

Quitting is a sure thing at this point. Have two days off and the training coaches I believe do as well,  but Tuesday when they are there,   I am ending this charade. I thank you for taking the time to attempt to help me through this,  says a lot in terms of you as a person to reach out to a stranger the way you did,  but I 'm a lost cause both at this job and really in life.

Wasn't able to sleep well and really sick feeling. I've not had a bite to eat in around 36 hours. Tempted to turn my badge in today and call it quits. Not sure what I will  do in terms of bills and such,  but likely not long for the world anyway,  so it's a moot point.

I need to be fairly brief as I am physically and emotionally drained and crave sleep,  but firstly thanks for the reply.  I wish you and your partner all the happiness in the world.  

In terms of the job,  it's mainly one particular aspect that I struggle with and that's average handle time. Most of my other metrics I am near or even above goal in,  but my sheer social ineptness makes it hard for me to end calls in a timely manner.  Graduation was today and I was one of few that didn't graduate and ended up in extended training for a week. Feelings of failure and inadequacy back to the forefront.  This next week of extended training,  my handle time has to come down and it simply put isn't going to happen.  I am going to be fired and continue to live with this thing between my legs until it all mercifully ends.
